latest.notes: The FULL Dhunn, now in Java: synced lyrics with 240 effects, 52 animated album-art designs, HD covers, the full equalizer, Monetag ads and the Support page — everything the Flutter app has, in just 306 KB.

changelog.notes: The full copy: everything from the Flutter Dhunn, rebuilt in pure Java.
changes: Everything added: this is now the complete Dhunn, not the simple player
Synced lyrics from LRCLIB with offline cache, sidecar .lrc files, custom lyrics editor and bulk download
240 lyrics effects in a grid with live previews, plus custom lyrics colour
52 animated album-art designs with a live-preview gallery
HD covers from iTunes and Deezer — single or bulk, with a Downloads screen
Full equalizer: this phone's own bands, system + custom presets, Bass Boost, Virtualizer, Loudness
Accent colours, cover-matched theme, Fluid Beat, switchable app icons
Library filters (short clips, folders), sort orders, song menu (Share, Rename, Details, Delete)
Session restore, battery banner, Monetag ads with the same friendly rules
Support Dhunn page with JazzCash, NayaPay, Easypaisa and Binance Pay
All of it in 306 KB — the Flutter edition is 10.5 MB

changelog.notes: First Java test build: the core player only.
changes: Core player: song list, search, player screen, background playback with notification controls
Just 106 KB — the size experiment that started it all

faqs.a: Yes — Dhunn is completely free. No ads, no subscriptions, no locked features.
No. Your songs play fully offline from your phone. Internet is only used for lyrics, HD cover images and checking for updates.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn need an internet connection?

faqs.a: Only for the Fluid Beat background: the app listens to the music's beat (not your voice) to animate the background. Nothing is ever recorded or sent anywhere.
faqs.q: Why does Dhunn ask for microphone permission?

faqs.a: When a new version is released, Dhunn shows an update message automatically. You can also check any time in Settings → Updates & FAQs → Check for updates.
Make sure you allowed the Music & audio permission, then go to Settings → My Library and scan your device again.
faqs.q: My songs are not showing up. What do I do?

faqs.a: Yes. Open the song, tap the edit (pencil) icon near the lyrics, and pick a lyrics file or write/paste your own. Your lyrics are saved and used offline.
faqs.q: Lyrics are missing for a song. Can I add my own?

faqs.a: No. There is no account, no sign-up and no tracking. Your music and your data never leave your phone.
faqs.q: Does Dhunn collect my personal data?
